overview: Slapstick is two-player air hockey with a race to seven goals. Move a paddle to defend your end and strike the puck toward the opponent’s goal. A local preview provides an AI opponent, while online matches use the separate game server.
rules: Put the puck into the opponent’s goal while protecting your own.
The first player to score seven goals wins.
Local preview uses an AI opponent; two-player online play uses the separate server.
controls: Mouse or left gamepad stick moves the paddle.
Escape opens the menu and Settings adjusts music/effects.
story: This is a mechanics-led puzzle or activity; the available game source does not establish a narrative campaign or named story cast.
characters_note: No named story characters are documented. The objects, markers and hazards shown here serve the game rules.
